recording.method: teacher-forced in 1024-token query chunks through the model's cache with explicit position_ids; FP32 log_softmax; own-token log-probability rounded to 6 decimals

load.device_map: balanced by decoder layer over the GPUs

note: token_ids tokenized with /model/tokenizer.json without special tokens; reference_logprobs[i] is the model-author log-probability of token_ids[i + 1] given token_ids[: i + 1]
